ETERNITY
 FADE IN
 EXT. STREET - DAY - ESTABLISHING SHOT
 with the Doric columned old building of the California Capitol in
 the background, sun rays splash off the tubas in a BRASS BAND
 playing cheerful music. A LARGE CROWD mumbles and bunches
 forward awaiting the Governor's arrival. A shiny black limo
 arrives, THE GOVERNOR heads for the official bunting draped dais,
 where a number of well dressed MEN AND WOMEN greet him warmly.
 After chatting for a few moments, the Governor and other dignitaries take their places at the dais. The Governor sits to the
 right of a rostrum studded with microphones, A DIGNIFIED WOMAN
 (JUDGE Malloy) sits at the left side of the rostrum,
 CLOSER SHOT - ROSTRUM
 Camera features the microphone studded rostrum, the Governor
 sitting to the right of the rostrum, and Judge Malloy sitting to
 the left. After conferring with the GENTLEMAN next to her, Judge
 Malloy stands up and heads for the rostrum, The crowd quiets
 down to a hush,
 With the rostrum in the center of the picture, Judge Malloy opens
 the ceremony.
 JUDGE Malloy
 We are honored to welcome Governor
 Delaney to this historic event, on
 this historic day, March First
 1985. In just a few moments, we
 will receive a special message from
 the people who founded the
 California Republic, fought and
 struggled to secure its
 independence, then, in 1&5, made
 it part of the greatest country in
 the world, the United States of
 America.
 The crowd applauds.
 JUDGE DALLAS
 And now, it gives me pleasure to
 introduce to you the man. who will
 supervise this event, Governor
